_key.description: Source gene, transcript, readout gene, screen and construct identifier

_from.description: Gene-to-transcript edge for the overexpressed construct.

log2FC.title: Log2 Fold Change
log2FC.description: DESeq2 log2 fold-change of ORF abundance in high versus low readout-gene FACS bins. Positive values indicate enrichment with higher readout-gene expression.

base_mean.title: Base DESeq2 mean
base_mean.description: DESeq2 mean normalized ORF counts across samples.

p_value.title: P-Value
p_value.description: Unadjusted DESeq2 p-value for the ORF to readout-gene association.

p_value_adj.title: Adjusted P-Value
p_value_adj.threshold: Used for significant when available: p_value_adj < 0.05.

significant.title: Significant?
significant.description: Boolean indicator of the significance of the transcript perturbation effect on gene expression.
significant.threshold: The adapter sets significant to true when p_value_adj is available and < 0.05; otherwise false. It does not fall back to p_value. Nonsignificant rows are retained.

morf_id.title: MORF ID
morf_id.description: ORF construct identifier from the MORF library (DESeq2 rowID / ORF table MORF_id).

enum: gene overexpression effect on gene expression

transcript_mapping_method.title: Transcript Mapping Method
enum: Catalog transcript RefSeq accession without version
transcript_mapping_method.description: Whether transcript IDs were supplied or recovered from Catalog transcript RefSeq cross-references, ignoring accession versions.
